titre: Adding my child to my CSSM health insurance, getting their certificate of entitlement and carte Vitale
resume: Add the child to your health insurance file at the CSSM, download their certificate of entitlement on ameli, and request their own carte Vitale from age 12 or 16.
aQuoiCaSert: A minor child is normally covered as a dependent (ayant droit) of one or both parents. In Mayotte, health insurance is managed by the CSSM (Caisse de sécurité sociale de Mayotte, Mayotte's social security fund), which issues the carte Vitale (health insurance card) and the certificate of entitlement (attestation de droits). The certificate proves that the child is covered: daycare, school, holiday centers and hospitals often ask for it. CSSM members can use an ameli account (the French health insurance website) for some procedures.
quiEstConcerne: Parents of a newborn, or of a child covered under only one of the two parents.
Separated parents who each want to be reimbursed for the child's healthcare.
Parents who are asked for a certificate of entitlement.
Young people aged 12 to 18 who need their own carte Vitale.
aSavoir: Newborn: declare the birth from your ameli account, under "Mes démarches"; the child is then added to your file and registered on your carte Vitale (CSSM page on Services Publics+).
Certificate of entitlement: download it from your ameli account once the child is added, or ask for it at the CSSM front desk.
Child's carte Vitale (national rule since August 2026): from 12 to 15, at a parent's request; from age 16, with the consent of a parent who holds parental authority. It is free.
The CSSM phone number is 02 69 61 91 91; do not use 36 46, which is given on the national ameli pages.
